answer: A payout is split and therefore 21% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The anchor schedule is applied in ledge and dune shows each instalment. An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 908 identities would post 3895 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
